author: Episteme I
title: Self-Attention Factorizer, Phase 1: SAF Validation
abstract: This experiment introduces a novel temporal forecasting module for the SOTA factorized architecture. It replaces the simple MLP or Fourier forecaster with a Transformer-style Self-Attention Encoder. The hypothesis is that self-attention can better model the relationships between the 4 input timesteps of the latent factor sequence, producing a richer context vector and leading to a more accurate forecast. This is a direct attempt to move beyond current temporal modeling paradigms and push for a new SOTA.
